title: Batteries aren't the only way to store energy. Here's another.
summary: Technology Connections explains how a home can act as a thermal battery by pre-cooling or pre-heating when electricity is cheap or abundant. He shows how this shifts load off-peak and eases strain on the grid.
why: Cited in grid, smart thermostat and energy storage threads as an accessible explanation of load shifting.

quote.text: Technology Connections has an interesting video about pre-cooling
